objective: Repair M275 after M279 by making every current-bank read, next-bank parent read/child write, weight/metadata transfer, bank-valid fence and role switch explicit under a conservative synchronous single-port PWP bank and one signed12 generator accumulator.

current_weight_bank.event: one 96-byte read for every current correction-source cycle

next_weight_bank.generator_event: 96-byte signed-INT8 weight read for each tree flip/output-block update
next_weight_bank.conflict_rule: fill completes before generator reads; no same-cycle fill/read

current_pwp_bank.event: one 144-byte child PWP read for every current PWP-hit cycle

next_pwp_bank.parent_read_event: one 144-byte parent PWP read cycle for each non-root, nonresident parent/output-block
next_pwp_bank.child_write_event: one 144-byte child PWP write on the final flip-update cycle of each tree edge/output-block
next_pwp_bank.conflict_rule: read and write never share a cycle; a nonresident parent read precedes all updates for that child

memory_and_port_contract.metadata_port: one descriptor read port independent of weight/PWP ports; descriptor is fetched once per edge/output-block and held through its update
memory_and_port_contract.dram_fill: weight, pattern and descriptor bytes are serial on one 32-byte/cycle fill link
memory_and_port_contract.generator_accumulator_residency: after a child write the accumulator holds only that child; root zero needs no SRAM read

capacity_contract.excluded: control flops, address/control queues and physical SRAM overhead; 61,776 bytes is a lower bound, not macro area

preparation_recurrence.formula: 387 + 8 * (exact MST flip count + nonresident parent-edge count in frozen Prim order)
preparation_recurrence.sample_boundary: cold preparation and cold bank activation for every sample; no cross-sample cache
preparation_recurrence.final_drain: two-cycle phase tail is charged, but no nonexistent next preparation or role switch

bank_lifecycle.prepare_start: invalidate next weight, PWP and metadata roles before any overwrite
bank_lifecycle.weight_valid: assert only after all 12,288 weight bytes are written
bank_lifecycle.metadata_valid: assert only after all 96 metadata bytes are written
bank_lifecycle.pwp_valid: assert only after the final child PWP write
bank_lifecycle.role_switch: allowed only when next weight/PWP/metadata are valid and the generator is idle; in-sample switch occupies the already charged two-cycle tail
bank_lifecycle.early_read_or_switch: forbidden and counted as a protocol violation

required_gates: strict SHA binding for all inputs and docs/359 remains unchanged
all 40 M248 payloads rehashed and all 17,280 M251 phases reconstructed
M251 aggregate work and stored-PWP cycles reproduced exactly
M267 tree flips, edges and frozen-order nonresident-parent counts reproduced
every current child-PWP and weight read plus every next parent read, child write, weight update and metadata read is counted
no same-bank single-port overlap, no use-before-valid and no early role switch
cold starts, 17,270 transitions including 30 operator boundaries, and final drains are charged
materializer-only ratio is separated from complete modeled Conv ratios

claim_boundary.admitted_if_pass: exact phase replay and conservative event-ledger feasibility for the isolated modeled PWP Conv schedule using two weight banks, two single-port PWP banks, two metadata banks and one signed12 generator accumulator
not_admitted: tree materializer as the source of the complete PWP Conv speedup
SRAM macro timing/area/energy, control/queue capacity, RTL, VCS, Formality, DC, PT, complete Conv RTL, system speedup, paper PPA or headline
zero on-chip PWP capacity or free generator/metadata energy
